keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Agustín Palavecino (Cruz Azul).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Gabriel Fernández (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jhohan Romaña (León) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Alfonso Alvarado (León).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Christopher Mora (León) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Cruz Azul 0, León 0.
Second Half begins Cruz Azul 0, León 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Juan Guevara (León).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Edgar Guerra (León) is shown the yellow card.
Iván Rodríguez (León) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Cruz Azul 1, León 0. Andrés Montaño (Cruz Azul) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Jesús Orozco (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, León. Juan Domínguez replaces Iván Rodríguez.
Substitution, León. Díber Cambindo replaces Edgar Guerra.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. José Paradela replaces Andrés Montaño.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Nicolás Ibáñez replaces Gabriel Fernández.
